definitions.gloss: waterfall meditation; waterfall ascetic practice; standing under a waterfall as spiritual training
definitions.explanation: A form of ascetic practice in which a person stands or sits under a waterfall, enduring the cold water as a means of spiritual purification and mental discipline. Rooted in Shinto and Buddhist traditions.

examples.japanese: {山寺|やまでら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{滝行|たきぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}した→体験する：09858_taikensuru⟧。
examples.english: I experienced waterfall meditation at a mountain temple.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{滝|たき}→滝：02219_taki⟧ (waterfall) and ⟦{行|ぎょう}→行：26669_gyou⟧ (ascetic practice; training). Part of the broader tradition of ⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧ (ascetic training) in Japanese religion.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditionally practiced by Buddhist monks and ⟦{山伏|やまぶし}→山伏：29920_yamabushi⟧ (mountain ascetics) as a form of ⟦{禊|みそぎ}→禊：13836_misogi⟧ (purification). The practitioner wears white clothing and chants sutras or prayers while standing under the waterfall. In recent years, some temples have opened {滝行|たきぎょう} to lay participants, making it a popular spiritual tourism activity.

- {滝行|たきぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to perform waterfall meditation
- {滝行|たきぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}する→体験する：09858_taikensuru⟧: to experience waterfall meditation
- {滝行|たきぎょう}⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧: waterfall meditation experience (program)
- {滝行|たきぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧: waterfall meditation site

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧: ascetic training; religious practice — the general term for spiritual training, of which {滝行|たきぎょう} is one specific form
- ⟦{禊|みそぎ}→禊：13836_misogi⟧: purification ritual — a Shinto cleansing practice, often involving cold water but not necessarily a waterfall
- ⟦{座禅|ざぜん}→座禅：09641_zazen⟧: seated Zen meditation — another form of spiritual practice, but done sitting rather than under water
